newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND SOON TO INVITE BIDS FOR OSTROLEKA MEAT FIRM.
newsitem.headline: POLAND SOON TO INVITE BIDS FOR OSTROLEKA MEAT FIRM.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry will soon invite investors to negotiate the purchase of between 10 and 55 percent of shares in meat firm Zaklady Miesne Ostroleka SA, a ministry official said on Thursday.

"The ministry is preparing an invitation announcement for negotiations with all entities interested in buying not less then 10 percent of the shares in Ostroleka," Stanislaw Hebda, head the firm's privatisation project, told Reuters.
Hebda would not say exactly when the invitation would appear in the Polish press but said interested parties would submit initial offers in April.
He said that according to Polish law, employees would receive up to 15 percent of Ostroleka's shares, as would farmers and fishermen cooperating with the firm.
Hebda said up to 10 percent of shares would be earmarked for Poland's pension fund programme currently forming, and five percent would go for restitution claims.
Ostroleka, which employs over 1,300, made a net loss of 3.3 million zlotys last year on sales of 98.5 million zlotys.
